plan: Plan track T21 (the OpenVibe inventory), ADR-054: step 2, the authority with Live's cosmetics as the first kinds
summary: OpenVibe.Inventory — one inventory for an OpenVibe account (ADR-054). Item kinds (a contract plus a renderer per surface), definitions, instances, the equipped set and an append-only ledger in its own PostgreSQL database. Issuers (services, apps) grant only within their namespace; people see and equip what they own; every movement is a ledger row and an inventory.* event. Nothing is sold, bought, traded or converted. Live's name effects, particles, hats and voices are the first kinds (70 definitions seeded at boot), and scripts/import-live.js moves Live's unlocks and equipped slots here, row for row.
works: Kinds and definitions seeded at boot from data/kinds.json and data/live-definitions.json (Live's catalog, its item ids kept as aliases)
Grants by an issuer within its namespace: idempotent per key, supply caps with serial numbers, a non-stackable item answers the one already owned; consume and revoke
Equip one item per slot (a person, or a service acting for them with X-OV-Subject); a batch read of up to 100 equipped sets in one query
Public reads (kinds, definitions, a person's inventory and equipped set) and the person's own full inventory
Definitions created and edited by their issuer; rarity, attributes and supply fixed once published; attributes validated against the kind's schema
Pages: home, every item by kind, one item, your inventory with plain equip forms, a person's public inventory, /updates
Events (inventory.item.granted/consumed/revoked/equipped/unequipped, inventory.definition.published) through the openvibe-sdk outbox
Account export and deletion (ADR-033) at the loopback POST /internal/events, subscriptions created at boot
scripts/import-live.js: dry run, --apply (origin migrated, unlock times kept, idempotent) and --verify (row for row)
notYet: Live reading and writing through Inventory (INVENTORY_AUTHORITY), then Live's tables dropped (ADR-054 §8)
Profiles on Network showing the showcase; equip in Chat, Community and Games
Creator submissions and staff review (the Workshop, ADR-054 §6)
Trading and a market: not before a money ADR (ADR-054 §5)
